prompt_en: Create a photorealistic editorial scene at a bright Raypunk solar-weather relay station suspended above a crimson salt desert. One unmistakably adult woman is the station mechanic in an ivory flight coverall with turquoise piping and a translucent collar. Her appearance follows the attached portrait only as a visual reference: long, center-parted, softly wavy near-black hair; warm brown almond-shaped eyes; an oval face, softly arched brows, and natural full lips. Compose one coherent pulp-space world: an airborne oversized mail rocket with a rounded bubble window and swept tail fins intersects three saturated ray lanes above alien terrain; the station unifies polished chrome, rounded pastel enamel housings, an atomic sunburst, and ribbed controls. She slides a triangular crystal key into the exposed photon semaphore while her other hand steadies a separate brass-edged glass lens. The same finned, ribbed photon navigator integrates rotating prisms, glowing vacuum tubes, analog calibration knobs, and star-chart dials; the key visibly energizes its three outgoing rays. Beside it, a separate diagnostic console pairs analog dials with a glowing waveform tube visibly aligned to those outputs. On a nearby workbench, a separate finned, ribbed transmitter power cell connects to the beacon by one luminous conduit, making the maintenance handoff legible. Use a medium operational frame to keep her face, both hands, all three devices, station, and rocket readable; motivated ray backlight and soft frontal fill preserve skin, crystal facets, contact, and photographic materials.
